steps.title: Make sure the counter is right
steps.goal: count words correctly, so later timings measure correct code
steps.method: write count.py, check one paragraph by hand
steps.expect: matches a hand count of 11 words

steps.title: Lock the rules in with tests
steps.hypothesis: the rules survive odd input, so a speed-up cannot quietly break counting
steps.method: 23 unit tests on punctuation, case and cut words

steps.title: Split reading from counting
steps.goal: time reading, splitting and counting apart, so the race shows where the time goes
steps.method: move each phase into a file of its own, keep the tests

steps.title: Make a big, realistic test text
steps.goal: real word frequencies, so the race is fair

steps.title: Race Counter against a loop
steps.hypothesis: Counter is faster, since it counts in C
steps.method: time both on the same words, 7 rounds
